Definition: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on a garment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dress, wear, clothe, put on clothing, be clothed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to put on clothes, be clothed, wear; 1a2) to put on, be clothed with (fig.); 1b) (Pual) to be fully clothed; 1c) (Hiphil) to clothe, array with, dress
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
